description_en: You can invoke ListHistoricalSkillGroupReport to obtain historical data reports for one or more skill groups under a specified instance.
description_zh: 调用ListHistoricalSkillGroupReport获取指定实例下的一个或多个技能组的历史数据报表
name: ListHistoricalSkillGroupReport

parameters.help_en: List of skill group IDs to query, provided as a JSON array string. Each array element is a skill group ID. This parameter is optional. The default value is empty, which means all skill groups in the current page are queried
parameters.help_zh: 待查询的技能组ID列表，格式为JSON数组的字符串，数组元素为技能组ID，非必填，默认为空，表示查询当前分页下的所有技能组
parameters.name: skill_group_id_list

parameters.help_en: Start time of the historical data to retrieve, formatted as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. This parameter is optional. The default value is 00:00:00 of the current day. The earliest allowed value is 180 days before the current time. The time precision for statistics is hourly, rounded down to the previous hour, and uses a closed interval
parameters.help_zh: 获取的历史数据的起始时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒，非必填，默认为当天的0时，最早为当前时间往前180天，统计的时间精度为小时，向前取整，闭区间
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: End time of the historical data to retrieve, formatted as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. This parameter is optional. The default value is the current time. The time precision for statistics is hourly, rounded down to the previous hour, and uses an open interval. For example, if the start time is 11:12:20 and the end time is 11:45:50, the aligned input time range becomes [11:00:00, 12:00:00), meaning greater than or equal to 11:00:00 and less than 12:00:00
parameters.help_zh: 获取的历史数据的终止时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒，非必填，默认为当前时间，统计的时间精度为小时，向后取整，开区间。例如：开始时间为11:12:20，结束时间为11:45:50，则对齐后的入参时间范围为[11:00:00, 12:00:00) ，即大于等于11点，小于12点
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: Media type. The default value is Audio. Other valid values include Chat and Video
parameters.help_zh: 媒体类型，默认是语音(Audio), 其他可选参数包括Chat和Video
parameters.name: media_type

List.description_en: List of historical data for skill groups.

items.description_en: Historical data for a skill group.

AnswerRate.description_en: Answer rate. Calculation Formula: CallsAnswered / CallsDialed. (Because acknowledgement events and answer events may fall into different time ranges, the result may exceed 100% in certain cases.)
AnswerRate.description_zh: 接通率，计算公式为：CallsAnswered/CallsDialed（由于接听事件与应答事件可能落在不同的时间范围内，所以某些情况下结果可能大于100%）

AverageCustomerRingTime.description_en: Average customer-side ring time, in seconds
AverageCustomerRingTime.description_zh: 平均客户侧振铃时长，单位秒

CallsCustomerAnswered.description_en: Number of calls answered by the customer

MaxCustomerRingTime.description_en: Maximum Customer-side ring time, in seconds
MaxCustomerRingTime.description_zh: 最大客户侧振铃时长，单位秒

TotalCustomerRingTime.description_en: Total Customer-side ring time, in seconds
TotalCustomerRingTime.description_zh: 总客户侧振岭时长，单位秒

AbandonRate.description_en: Abandon rate. Calculation Formula: CallsAbandoned / CallsOffered (Because abandonment events and assignment events may fall into different time ranges, the result may exceed 100% in certain cases)
AbandonRate.description_zh: 放弃率。计算公式为：CallsAbandoned/CallsOffered（由于放弃事件与分配事件可能落在不同的时间范围内，所以某些情况下结果可能大于100%）

AverageAbandonTime.description_en: Average abandonment duration, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalAbandonTime / CallsAbandoned
AverageAbandonTime.description_zh: 平均放弃时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalAbandonTime/CallsAbandoned

AverageAbandonedInQueueTime.description_en: Average queue abandonment duration, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalAbandonedInQueueTime / CallsAbandonedInQueue
AverageAbandonedInQueueTime.description_zh: 平均排队放弃时长，单位秒。计算公式为： TotalAbandonedInQueueTime/CallsAbandonedInQueue

AverageAbandonedInRingTime.description_en: Average ringing abandonment duration, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalAbandonedInRingTime / CallsAbandonedInRing
AverageAbandonedInRingTime.description_zh: 平均振铃放弃时长，单位秒。计算公式为： TotalAbandonedInRingTime/CallsAbandonedInRing

AverageFirstResponseTime.description_en: Average first response time for chat sessions, in seconds
AverageFirstResponseTime.description_zh: Chat会话平均首次响应时长，单位为秒

AverageHoldTime.description_en: Average call hold duration, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalHoldTime / CallsHold
AverageHoldTime.description_zh: 平均通话保持时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalHoldTime/CallsHold

AverageResponseTime.description_en: Average response time for chat sessions

AverageRingTime.description_en: Average ring time, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalRingTime / CallsRinged
AverageRingTime.description_zh: 平均振铃时长，单位秒。计算公式为： TotalRingTime/CallsRinged

AverageTalkTime.description_en: Average talk time, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalTalkTime / CallsHandled
AverageTalkTime.description_zh: 平均通话时长，单位秒。计算公式为： TotalTalkTime/CallsHandled

AverageWaitTime.description_en: Average wait time, which is the average duration a caller waits before an agent answers the call. Calculation Formula: TotalWaitTime / CallsHandled
AverageWaitTime.description_zh: 平均等待时长，平均每通电话的坐席接起前等待时长。计算公式为：TotalWaitTime/CallsHandled

AverageWorkTime.description_en: Average post-processing duration, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalWorkTime / CallsHandled
AverageWorkTime.description_zh: 平均话后处理时长，单位秒。计算公式为： TotalWorkTime/CallsHandled

CallsAbandoned.description_en: Quantity of abandoned calls. Calculation Formula: CallsAbandonedInQueue + CallsAbandonedInRing

CallsAbandonedInQueue.description_en: Number of calls abandoned in queue, which refers to the number of calls where the customer hung up after entering the queue but before being answered
CallsAbandonedInQueue.description_zh: 队列放弃量，即电话进入队列之后在排队环节客户挂机的数量

CallsAbandonedInRing.description_en: Ring abandonment count, which is the number of calls where the customer hung up while the agent's phone was ringing
CallsAbandonedInRing.description_zh: 振铃放弃量，即坐席振铃中客户挂机的数量

CallsAttendedTransferIn.description_en: Transfer-in volume, which refers to the number of calls transferred to this skill group from other skill groups. Transfers between agents within the same skill group are not counted. If an agent is signed into multiple skill groups simultaneously, the call is attributed to the first skill group the agent signed into. If a single call is transferred multiple times from other skill groups to this skill group, each transfer is counted separately. The same rule applies below
CallsAttendedTransferIn.description_zh: 咨询转入量，即由其他技能组发起的咨询转接到该技能组的电话数量，同一技能组内坐席间的转接不计数。若一个坐席同时迁入多个技能组，则该电话的统计归属于签入的第一个技能组。若一通电话由其他技能组多次转接到该技能组，每次转接算一次。下同

CallsAttendedTransferOut.description_en: Quantity of attended transfer-out calls, which refers to the number of calls transferred from this skill group to another skill group via consultation. Transfers between agents within the same skill group are not counted
CallsAttendedTransferOut.description_zh: 咨询转出量，即由该技能组发起的咨询转接到其他技能组的电话数量，同一技能组内坐席间的转接不计数

CallsBlindTransferIn.description_en: Number of blind transfer-in calls, which refers to the number of calls directly transferred to this skill group from other skill groups. Transfers between agents within the same skill group are not counted. If an agent is signed into multiple skill groups simultaneously, the call is attributed to the first skill group the agent signed into. If a single call is transferred multiple times from other skill groups to this skill group, each transfer is counted separately. The same rule applies below
CallsBlindTransferIn.description_zh: 直接转入量，即由其他技能组发起的直接转接到该技能组的电话数量，同一技能组内坐席间的转接不计数。若一个坐席同时签入多个技能组，则该电话的统计归属于签入的第一个技能组。若一通电话由其他技能组多次转接到该技能组，每次转接算一次。下同

CallsBlindTransferOut.description_en: Number of blind transfer-out calls, which refers to the number of calls directly transferred from this skill group to another skill group. Transfers between agents within the same skill group are not counted
CallsBlindTransferOut.description_zh: 直接转出量，即由该技能组发起的直接转接到其他技能组的电话数量，同一技能组内坐席间的转接不计数

CallsHandled.description_en: Acknowledgement count, which is the number of times agents answered calls. For a single call that enters a queue multiple times, if it is answered by multiple agents after one queue entry, it is counted as one
CallsHandled.description_zh: 应答量，即坐席应答的次数。一通电话每次进入队列后，若被多个坐席应答，算一次

CallsHold.description_en: Hold count, which is the number of times calls were placed on hold. Each time a call enters the queue and experiences multiple holds, it counts as one
CallsHold.description_zh: 保持量，即发生通话保持的次数。一通电话每次进入队列后，若发生多次通话保持，算一次

CallsOffered.description_en: Assigned call volume, which is the number of calls assigned to this skill group, including calls assigned through queues and calls assigned via transfers (consultation transfers and direct transfers). Calculation Formula: CallsQueued + CallsBlindTransferIn + CallsAttendedTransferIn
CallsOffered.description_zh: 分配量，即分配给该技能组的电话数量，包括通过队列分配的电话数量和通过转接（咨询转接和直接转接）分配的电话数量。计算公式为：CallsQueued+CallsBlindTransferIn+CallsAttentandedTransferIn

CallsOverflow.description_en: Overflow count, which is the number of calls that experienced queue (skill group) overflow. If a single call enters the same queue multiple times, each overflow is counted separately
CallsOverflow.description_zh: 溢出量，即发生队列（技能组）溢出的电话数量。若一通电话多次进入同一队列，每次溢出算一次

CallsQueued.description_en: Number of inbound calls entering a queue (skill group). If a single call enters the same queue multiple times, each entry is counted separately
CallsQueued.description_zh: 呼入场景进入队列（技能组）的电话数量，若一通电话多次进入同一队列，每次进入算一次

CallsQueuingFailed.description_en: Queue Failure Quantity, which is the number of calls where the customer hung up after entering the queue but before being answered
CallsQueuingFailed.description_zh: 队列失败量，即电话进入队列之后在排队环节客户挂机的数量

CallsQueuingOverflow.description_en: Quantity of calls that overflowed from the queue. Queue overflow refers to calls that overflow while queuing in IVR
CallsQueuingOverflow.description_zh: 队列溢出的通话数量，队列溢出指通话在IVR排队时队列溢出

CallsQueuingTimeout.description_en: Number of calls that timed out during the queuing phase
CallsQueuingTimeout.description_zh: 在排队阶段超时的通话数量

CallsRinged.description_en: Number of calls that rang to agents. Each time a call enters the queue and is assigned to multiple agents, resulting in ringing, it counts as one
CallsRinged.description_zh: 坐席振铃的电话数量，一通电话每次进入队列后，若分配给多个座席并产生了振铃，算一次

CallsTimeout.description_en: Timeout count, which is the number of calls that experienced queue (skill group) timeout. If a single call enters the same queue multiple times, each timeout is counted separately
CallsTimeout.description_zh: 超时量，即发生队列（技能组）超时的电话数量。若一通电话多次进入同一队列，每次超时算一次

HandleRate.description_en: Acknowledgement rate. Calculation Formula: CallsHandled / CallsOffered (because acknowledgement events and assign events may fall into different time ranges, the result may exceed 100% in certain cases)
HandleRate.description_zh: 应答率。计算公式为：CallsHandled/CallsOffered（由于应答事件与分配事件可能落在不同的时间范围内，所以某些情况下结果可能大于100%）

MaxAbandonedInQueueTime.description_en: Maximum queue abandonment duration, in seconds
MaxAbandonedInQueueTime.description_zh: 最大排队放弃时长，单位秒

MaxAbandonedInRingTime.description_en: Maximum ring abandonment duration, in seconds
MaxAbandonedInRingTime.description_zh: 最大振铃放弃时长，单位秒

MaxHoldTime.description_en: Maximum call hold time, in seconds
MaxHoldTime.description_zh: 最大通话保持时长，单位秒

MaxWorkTime.description_zh: 最大话后处理时长，单位秒

SatisfactionIndex.description_en: Satisfaction index, which is the average of the satisfaction keypress digits (single-digit numbers)
SatisfactionIndex.description_zh: 满意度指数，即满意度按键数字（1位数字）的平均值

SatisfactionRate.description_en: Satisfaction rate. Calculation Formula: Count of evaluations marked as satisfied / Count of satisfaction survey responses
SatisfactionRate.description_zh: 满意率，计算公式为：标记为满意的评价数/满意度调查响应次数

ServiceLevel20.description_en: Service level within 20 seconds: number of calls with wait time less than or equal to 20 seconds divided by CallsQueued
ServiceLevel20.description_zh: 20秒服务水平，等待时长小于等于20秒的电话数量/CallsQueued

TotalAbandonedInQueueTime.description_en: Total queue abandonment duration, in seconds
TotalAbandonedInQueueTime.description_zh: 总排队放弃时长，单位秒

TotalAbandonedInRingTime.description_en: Total ring abandonment duration, in seconds
TotalAbandonedInRingTime.description_zh: 总振铃放弃时长，单位秒

TotalHoldTime.description_en: Total call hold duration, in seconds
TotalHoldTime.description_zh: 总通话保持时长，单位秒

TotalMessagesSent.description_en: Total number of messages sent in chat sessions

TotalMessagesSentByAgent.description_en: Total number of messages sent by agents in chat sessions
TotalMessagesSentByAgent.description_zh: Chat会话中坐席发送的总消息量

TotalMessagesSentByCustomer.description_en: Total number of messages sent by the customer in chat sessions
TotalMessagesSentByCustomer.description_zh: Chat会话中客户发送的总消息量

TotalWorkTime.description_zh: 总话后处理时长，单位秒

AnswerRate.description_en: Answer rate. Calculation Formula: CallsAnswered / CallsDialed. (Because the call answering event and the acknowledgement event may fall into different time ranges, the result may exceed 100% in certain cases.)
AnswerRate.description_zh: 接通率，计算公式为：CallsAnswered/CallsDialed（由于接听事件与应答事件可能落在不同的时间范围内，所以某些情况下结果可能大于100%）

AverageDialingTime.description_en: Average dial-up duration, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalDialingTime / CallsDialed
AverageDialingTime.description_zh: 平均拨号时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalDialingTime/CallsDialed

AverageHoldTime.description_en: Average call hold duration, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalHoldTime / CallsHold
AverageHoldTime.description_zh: 平均通话保持时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalHoldTime/CallsHold

AverageRingTime.description_en: Average ring time, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalRingTime / CallsRinged
AverageRingTime.description_zh: 平均振铃时长，单位秒。计算公式为： TotalRingTime/CallsRinged

AverageTalkTime.description_en: Average talk time, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalTalkTime / CallsAnswered
AverageTalkTime.description_zh: 平均通话时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalTalkTime/CallsAnswered

AverageWorkTime.description_en: Average post-processing duration per call, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalWorkTime / CallsDialed
AverageWorkTime.description_zh: 平均话后处理时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalWorkTime/CallsDialed

CallsAttendedTransferIn.description_en: Transfer-in volume for consultation, which refers to the number of calls transferred to this skill group from other skill groups for consultation. Transfers between agents within the same skill group are not counted. If an agent joins multiple skill groups simultaneously, the call is attributed to the first skill group the agent signed into. If a single call is transferred multiple times from other skill groups to this skill group, each transfer is counted separately. The same rule applies below
CallsAttendedTransferIn.description_zh: 咨询转入量，即由其他技能组发起的咨询转接到该技能组的电话数量，同一技能组内坐席间的转接不计数。若一个坐席同时迁入多个技能组，则该电话的统计归属于签入的第一个技能组。若一通电话由其他技能组多次转接到该技能组，每次转接算一次。下同

CallsAttendedTransferOut.description_en: Quantity of attended transfer-out calls, which refers to the number of calls transferred from this skill group to another skill group for consultation. Transfers between agents within the same skill group are not counted
CallsAttendedTransferOut.description_zh: 咨询转出量，即由该技能组发起的咨询转接到其他技能组的电话数量，同一技能组内坐席间的转接不计数

CallsBlindTransferIn.description_en: Quantity of direct transfer-in calls, which refers to the number of calls directly transferred to this skill group from other skill groups. Transfers between agents within the same skill group are not counted. If an agent is signed into multiple skill groups simultaneously, the call is attributed to the first skill group the agent signed into. If a single call is transferred multiple times from other skill groups to this skill group, each transfer is counted separately. The same rule applies below
CallsBlindTransferIn.description_zh: 直接转入量，即由其他技能组发起的直接转接到该技能组的电话数量，同一技能组内坐席间的转接不计数。若一个坐席同时签入多个技能组，则该电话的统计归属于签入的第一个技能组。若一通电话由其他技能组多次转接到该技能组，每次转接算一次。下同

CallsBlindTransferOut.description_en: Quantity of direct transfer-out calls, which refers to the number of calls directly transferred from this skill group to other skill groups. Transfers between agents within the same skill group are not counted
CallsBlindTransferOut.description_zh: 直接转出量，即由该技能组发起的直接转接到其他技能组的电话数量，同一技能组内坐席间的转接不计数

CallsHold.description_en: Number of calls placed on hold. If a call is placed on hold multiple times before being transfer-out from the current skill group, it counts as one occurrence
CallsHold.description_zh: 保持量，即发生通话保持的电话数量。一通电话在转出当前技能组之前，若发生多次通话保持，算一次

CallsRinged.description_en: Number of calls that rang to agents. Each time a call enters the queue and is assigned to multiple agents, resulting in ringing, it counts as one occurrence
CallsRinged.description_zh: 坐席振铃的电话数量，一通电话每次进入队列后，若分配给多个座席并产生了振铃，算一次

MaxHoldTime.description_en: Maximum hold time during calls, in seconds
MaxHoldTime.description_zh: 最大通话保持时长，单位秒

MaxWorkTime.description_en: Maximum post-processing duration per call, in seconds
MaxWorkTime.description_zh: 最大话后处理时长，单位秒

SatisfactionIndex.description_en: Satisfaction index, which is the average value of the single-digit satisfaction key presses
SatisfactionIndex.description_zh: 满意度指数，即满意度按键数字（1位数字）的平均值

SatisfactionRate.description_en: Satisfaction rate. Calculation Formula: Quantity of evaluations marked as satisfied divided by the Count of satisfaction survey responses
SatisfactionRate.description_zh: 满意率，计算公式为：标记为满意的评价数/满意度调查响应次数

TotalHoldTime.description_en: Total call hold duration, in seconds
TotalHoldTime.description_zh: 总通话保持时长，单位秒

TotalWorkTime.description_zh: 总话后处理时长，单位秒

AverageBreakTime.description_en: Average break duration, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalBreakTime / Break Count. Break Count is a non-API statistical field
AverageBreakTime.description_zh: 平均小休时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalBreakTime/小休次数。小休次数为非接口统计字段

AverageHoldTime.description_en: Average call hold duration, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalHoldTime / (Inbound CallsHold + Outbound CallsHold)
AverageHoldTime.description_zh: 平均通话保持时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalHoldTime/(呼入CallsHold+呼出CallsHold)

AverageReadyTime.description_en: Average ready time, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalReadyTime / Count of ready events. The count of ready events is not an API statistics field
AverageReadyTime.description_zh: 平均就绪时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalReadyTime/就绪次数。就绪次数为非接口统计字段

AverageTalkTime.description_en: Average talk time, in seconds. Calculation formula: TotalTalkTime / (CallsAnswered + CallsHandled)
AverageTalkTime.description_zh: 平均通话时长，单位秒。计算公式为： TotalTalkTime/(CallsAnswered+CallsHandled)

AverageWorkTime.description_en: Average post-processing time, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalWorkTime / TotalCalls
AverageWorkTime.description_zh: 平均话后处理时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalWorkTime/TotalCalls

Count.description_en: Number of occurrences of this break type
Count.description_zh: 此类型小休的发生次数

Duration.description_en: Total duration of this break type, in seconds
Duration.description_zh: 此类型小休的总计发生时长，单位为秒

MaxHoldTime.description_en: Maximum call hold duration, in seconds
MaxHoldTime.description_zh: 最大通话保持时长，单位秒

MaxWorkTime.description_zh: 最大话后处理时长，单位秒

OccupancyRate.description_en: Agent occupancy rate. Calculation formula: (TotalWorkTime + TotalTalkTime) / TotalLoggedInTime
OccupancyRate.description_zh: 座席利用率，计算公式为： (TotalworkTime + TotalTalkTime ) / TotalLoggedInTime

SatisfactionIndex.description_en: Satisfaction index, which is the average value of the satisfaction keypress digits (single-digit numbers)
SatisfactionIndex.description_zh: 满意度指数，即满意度按键数字（1位数字）的平均值

SatisfactionRate.description_en: Satisfaction rate. Calculation Formula: Number of responses marked as satisfied / Count of satisfaction survey responses
SatisfactionRate.description_zh: 满意率，计算公式为：标记为满意的评价数/满意度调查响应次数

TotalCalls.description_en: Total call volume. Calculation Formula: CallsOffered + CallsDialed
TotalCalls.description_zh: 总电话量。计算公式为：CallsOffered + CallsDialed

TotalLoggedInTime.description_en:
Total logon time, in seconds.  
Note: Excludes offline and short break durations
TotalLoggedInTime.description_zh:
总登录时长，单位秒。
注意：不含离线和小休时长

TotalWorkTime.description_zh: 总话后处理时长，单位秒
